title: UNDERSTAR — A past he won't explain
direction: A practical miner whose occasional memories suggest an older, stranger life. Natural speaking voice; clear consonants. Short plain sentences. No whispering, monster voice, reverb, invented accent, theatrical laugh, or lore explanation. The mystery is in the words.
directionNote: Direction is editorial guidance. These auditions use the provider's stock Leo and Rex voices with plain text; no separate acting prompt is supported by this generator.
rules: Proposed conditions for approval; these recordings are not connected to the game.
One speaker at a time. Skip if NPC dialogue, narration, a reveal, a menu, death, or a scene transition is active.
Choose a valid event first, then one matching line. Random choice never supplies a missing context.
At most one player line every 90 seconds. Mystery remarks are at least four minutes apart and limited to two per ten minutes.
Warnings use their own short event expiry, but respect the same speech gap. Safety must remain understandable from game sound and visuals.
Never queue a remark to play after its context is gone. If the channel is busy, discard it.
Each exact line can play at most once per session. First-discovery opportunities stay consumed when the same save is reloaded.
Routine digging, combo numbers, small sales, repeat common ore, walking, idle time, and cosmetic bag fullness remain silent.

groups.title: Gold, actually collected
groups.condition: Gold material was added to inventory for the first time in this save. This is ore, not the gold currency counter. Player is safe and no other speaker is active.
groups.exclude: Never on another ore, a sale, a coin reward, a repeat gold pickup, or a reveal.
groups.frequency: One eligible chance per save; play immediately within 4 seconds or skip.
groups.evidence: PlayerVoiceRetentionBridge materialFound callback; a strict gold-material check and safe-state gate must be added.

clips.hint: A practical observation with an uncomfortable edge.

clips.text: Gold. That used to buy silence.
clips.hint: Suggests a past involving secrets, without explaining it.

groups.title: A Star, in your hands
groups.condition: The first Star in this save was actually awarded: the Star balance increased by a positive amount. Player is safe and the collection scene has finished.
groups.exclude: Never on a Star-looking effect, a zero-gain reward, a failed pickup, a repeat Star, or while narration is speaking.
groups.frequency: One eligible chance per save; within 4 seconds of the end of the collection scene or skip.
groups.evidence: PlaySceneSetup Star gained event needs a positive-gain guard and explicit presentation-complete eligibility.

clips.hint: Recognition that the player cannot yet explain.

clips.text: The Stars used to know me.
clips.hint: Raises a larger question about who he was.

groups.title: A face in the depths
groups.condition: A Titan was genuinely unlocked for the first time. Its reveal and narration have finished; the same Titan is still visible and the player is safe.
groups.exclude: Never over the cinematic, on an already-known Titan, or after the player leaves the discovery.
groups.frequency: One eligible chance per Titan; within 4 seconds after its reveal ends or skip.
groups.evidence: TitanDiscoverySystem currently emits during discovery. A narration-complete gate and visible-Titan identity check are required.

clips.hint: Simple recognition, leaving the relationship unknown.
A dry admission of an unexplained history.

groups.title: Rocks are about to fall
groups.condition: A loose-rock warning overlaps the player's actual danger area and dangerous rocks have not already passed. The voice can start immediately, within 1.5 seconds.
groups.exclude: Never for distant quakes, merely standing underground, already-finished danger, or while another voice is speaking. Never invent a safe direction.
groups.frequency: At most once per quake episode; obey the 90-second speech gap.
groups.evidence: EarthquakeSystem warning proximity currently accepts any value above zero. Require actual threatened area and fresh warning.

clips.hint: Recommended safety wording: immediate and concrete.
A little character, at the cost of an explicit instruction.

groups.title: He survived that
groups.event: After a personal quake near miss
groups.condition: This quake put the player inside a real rock danger area or caused a recorded near miss. The player survived, debris has stopped, and the area has been calm for 3 seconds.
groups.exclude: Never after a distant/global quake, during falling debris, after death, or without proof the player was exposed. Skip if this quake already received a warning voice.
groups.frequency: One line at most per personally experienced quake; within 5 seconds of becoming safe, obey all mystery and speech gaps.
groups.evidence: PlayerVoiceRetentionBridge quake recap currently uses global destruction. Track per-player exposure and completion before allowing this line.

clips.text: Still breathing. That makes a change.
clips.hint: A survival joke with a suggestion of something stranger.
The clearest unsettling implication; use very rarely.

groups.title: Back under the sky
groups.condition: Player returned to Town after reaching at least 300 metres on this trip, is now above ground, and no shop or NPC conversation is open. F1 additionally requires actual daylight.
groups.exclude: Never for a short surface loop, shop entry, underground teleport, or a menu. F1 must never play at night.
groups.frequency: One eligible chance per qualifying return; within 4 seconds while still above ground, obey all mystery and speech gaps.
groups.evidence: PlayerVoiceRetentionBridge expedition summary provides trip depth. Gate current surface location, dialogue, and time of day explicitly.

clips.hint: Hints at a former life; daytime only.
Makes his origin uncertain, using a visible part of the world.
